## Install

1. Download `Shepit-*.zip` below, unzip it and move `Shepit.app` to `/Applications`.
2. The app is not notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once, then go to
   System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**. Or run
   `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Shepit.app` in Terminal.
3. Grant Microphone and Accessibility when asked. After an update, macOS may ask for
   Accessibility again, because the app is signed ad hoc.

Requires macOS 26 on Apple silicon.
